ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the reasons behind the growing trend.
questions: What are the main causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent future cases of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that investigating Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could reveal a larger issue with the state's healthcare system. By analyzing data and following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that could lead to further investigations.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Funding Freeze on Local Governments
ideas.description: This story would explore the effects of the federal funding freeze on local governments and child care advocates.
questions: How are local governments being affected by the federal funding freeze?
What are the long-term consequences of the funding freeze on child care programs?
ideas.insight: I think that investigating the impact of the federal funding freeze on local governments could reveal a lack of transparency and accountability in the federal funding system. By analyzing public records and speaking with whistleblowers, we may be able to uncover a larger scandal.
